architecture.family: DeepONet: branch [3,w,w,p], trunk [1,q,p], Hadamard combine, head Linear(p,6)
architecture.activation: relu between branch layers and after every trunk layer (none on branch output or head)

normalization.input_scaling: min-max on the branch input [Y0, T]; trunk input tau = t/t_end
normalization.output: normalized species u_hat (compared directly with normalized targets)

in_training_evaluation.parameter_state: before this epoch's optimizer update -- the same state that produced the epoch's training loss
in_training_evaluation.normalizer: train-only min-max (never refit on test data)

provenance.architecture: paper's prose description with the authors' clarified branch input [TG0, ROH0, T0]: 308 parameters at w=8, as reported
provenance.optimizer_and_init: REFERENCE-DERIVED from deeponet/src/deeponet_dataset.py (relu, Glorot normal, biased Linear, Adam lr=1e-3); not stated by the ChemKAN paper
